title: Odin Code Auditor rules file
description: Schema for odin_rules.jsonc. Edit the rules file freely; this schema validates it.

extends.description: Optional preset profile names (odin-core, odin-pvg03-rpg, odin-cli, odin-strict). Phase 2 resolves these.

extra_rules.description: IDs of project-local rules to add on top of the extends profile.

id.description: Stable uppercase identifier (e.g. ALLOC-001, DS-002, ODIN-003).

category.description: Bucket for grouping in the report.

severity.description: error blocks strict-mode CI, warning shows in report, info is informational.

static.description: True if a regex/heuristic can detect it without LLM. Phase 2 implements the static detectors.

scope.description: Glob patterns (e.g. ['*.odin']) this rule applies to.

pattern.description: Optional regex (Python re syntax). Mutually exclusive with 'detect' in practice, but schema allows either.

detect.description: Optional named heuristic to implement in scanner.py (e.g. alloc-in-loop, defer-in-loop).

explanation.description: Why this rule exists. Citable, explains the underlying principle.

kb_sources.description: Repo-relative paths to KB files that justify this rule.

lesson_refs.description: Skool / programvideogames lesson IDs (e.g. '088'). Phase 3 links these to INDEX.md.

fix_suggestion.description: Optional code-level hint on how to fix the violation.
